mechanism_narrative: The recent upward trend in retail and recreation mobility, observed from t-1w to t-0w, indicates a sustained recovery momentum that will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean of the last 28 days, contradicting the observed upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week increase in parks mobility, often linked to improving weather or seasonal factors, signals a broader willingness for outdoor activities that will spill over into increased retail and recreation visits over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next 14 days despite PARKS showing a strong week-on-week rise of over 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in workplace mobility suggests a shift towards remote work or reduced commuting, which directly translates to lower weekday footfall in retail and recreation establishments, leading to a decrease in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean of the last 28 days, despite a significant drop in WORKPLACES mobility.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous sharp decline in workplace mobility and increase in residential mobility indicates a strong shift towards staying at home, which will significantly reduce out-of-home discretionary spending and lead to a decrease in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 10 points week-on-week AND RESIDENTIAL rises by more than 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days when both WORKPLACES falls by more than 10 points and RESIDENTIAL rises by more than 1 point week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The persistent low and stagnant transit station activity reflects a lack of confidence or necessity for public transport, which acts as a fundamental constraint on broader mobility and will hinder any significant recovery in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows a strong upward trend over the next 28 days despite transit station activity remaining flat and significantly below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Stable and positive grocery and pharmacy mobility indicates a consistent baseline level of essential community activity and confidence, providing a floor for discretionary spending and supporting a modest increase in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines significantly over the next 28 days despite grocery and pharmacy mobility remaining stable and above baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent strong week-on-week increase in both parks and retail-and-recreation mobility signals a broad-based return to out-of-home activities and increased public comfort, which will amplify the positive trend in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC rises by more than 2 points week-on-week AND PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines in the next 14 days despite both RETAIL_REC and PARKS showing strong week-on-week increases.

mechanism_narrative: The immediate and significant drop in workplace mobility will cause a rapid, short-term reduction in weekday retail and recreation activity as fewer people commute and spend time near their workplaces, leading to a dip in RETAIL_REC in the very next week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the immediate next week following a sharp decline of more than 10 points in WORKPLACES mobility.
